interface.name: vela_output_preview_manager_v1
interface.description: An extension to wlr-output-management. Protect a configuration before sending its apply request, on the same Wayland connection. Only one preview may be pending. Other configuration applies are rejected until it finishes. Ordinary unprotected clients retain their existing behavior.

entry.name: invalid_configuration
entry.summary: not a configuration owned by this client

request.name: protect
request.description: configuration is the object ID of a zwlr_output_configuration_v1 belonging to this client. A protected configuration cannot be applied without its preview, including after destroying or expiring the preview. The compositor bounds the time allowed to submit apply as well as the confirmation time. preserve_position can name a disabled output to re-enable at its remembered position, which output-management does not advertise while it is disabled. An empty string keeps the configuration's explicitly requested position.

arg.name: configuration
arg.summary: configuration object ID on this connection

arg.name: preserve_position
arg.summary: disabled output whose remembered position should be kept, or empty

interface.name: vela_output_preview_v1
interface.description: The compositor captures the previous configuration before applying the protected change. Until confirmation, no new settings are persisted. Timeout, revert, destruction, or client disconnection restores the surviving outputs; newly connected outputs are left alone. Confirmation attempts to persist the new settings. If saving fails, the applied settings remain active and finished reports save_failed. If a failed apply cannot be fully rolled back, finished reports restore_failed. Requests after finished have no effect.

entry.name: save_failed
entry.summary: configuration accepted but could not be persisted

event.name: applied
event.description: Sent only after a successful apply. The deadline is owned by the compositor; clients may display a countdown but cannot extend it.
